_note: Screenshots for npm run shoot. Each sequence opens one page (url; width and height of the window in CSS px, default 1440 x 900; or "phone": true for 390 x 716 as a phone) and runs its steps in order. Steps: {"wait": ms}, {"key": "p"}, {"type": "text"}, {"hover": "css selector"}, {"click": "css selector", "count": 2, "dx": 0, "dy": 0}, {"hide": "selector"}, {"show": "selector"}, {"eval": "javascript that returns something to print"}, {"shot": "name"} (saves public/shots/name.png). Example: {"url": "http://localhost:5173/", "steps": [{"shot": "home"}, {"click": "h1"}, {"shot": "home-clicked"}]}. 'language' (optional) overrides the page language; default is the spoken language from film.json.
